name: What are common signs a foreclosed kitchen needs more than a refresh?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs a foreclosed kitchen needs more than a refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs a foreclosed kitchen needs more than a refresh include water damage, significant structural issues, outdated or non-functional plumbing and electrical systems, and pest infestations. If the layout is completely dysfunctional or the cabinets are beyond refacing due to severe damage, a full renovation might be more cost-effective in the long run. A professional assessment can determine the true extent of necessary repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: If a foreclosed kitchen has severe water damage, structural issues, non-functional plumbing/electrical, or pests, it likely needs a full renovation.
